summary: Selects between a live sub-object pointer and null based on a boolean flag at this+0x138 (this[78]). Reads the object's vtable pointer at this+0 and calls the virtual method at vtable+0x3C with an integer enable/disable argument (1 when the flag is set, 0 otherwise). On the enabled path it returns the sub-object pointer this+70; on the disabled path it returns null.
